Name: Solarium (Rooftop Spa House)
Author: bahbahrah
Description:
Adds the solarium on the rooftop of the spa, where you can grow crops and trees from any season like the greenhouse.

You can freely enter the solarium after you met certain conditions.

[b][font=Georgia][size=5]Conditions:[/size][/font][/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*]Community Center is fixed.[i] (Not Joja route!)[/i]
[*]Has at least 8 hearts with both Evelyn and Caroline.
[/list][/spoiler]

[b][font=Georgia][size=5]Unlocked Event:[/size][/font][/b]
[spoiler]After you met the conditions, Caroline will visit the farm on a sunny day and give you a solarium key. The ladder to the rooftop only appears the [u][b]next day[/b][/u] after seeing the event.[/spoiler]

This mod also [u]slightly[/u] edited [b]Linus's schedules:[/b]
[spoiler]After the solarium is unlocked, Linus will visit the solarium in Fall and Winter. [i](So he is no longer standing creepy next to the spa house in Fall and the spa entrance in Winter...)[/i]

If you enter the solarium when Linus is present on the map. A very short cutscene will trigger.[/spoiler]

[font=Georgia][size=5][b]Compatible:[/b][/size][/font]
Currently is [b][u]incompatible[/u][/b] with other redesigned Bathhouse Entry maps.
